expected_response.discriminating_failure: A permitted edit whose registered formula changes a coordinate observable with a reproducible signed contrast (same-sign batch fraction >= 0.857, q < 0.05) would justify an edit over retention.
expected_response.predicted_direction: No change to the incumbent coordinate reward; endpoint pointcloud behavior unchanged.
expected_response.primary_observable: Final predicted target affinity (primary); validity and strain secondary.

failure_modes: Selecting a permitted edit that does not change the observable carrying the leading pair-kernel contrast would be an unconnected reward edit.
Treating pair-kernel, moment, turnover or joint-motion diagnostics as if the executing pointcloud scalar contained those terms.
Treating recorded joint-head survival credit as decoded terminal affinity benefit.
Using observed-node linear fits as a temporal teacher despite polynomial_accepted false and strong sign conflicts.
Proposing a temperature edit, which is an interface violation.
Constraining global centroid coordinates on weak or null contrasts.
rationale: Retain the incumbent. The Analyst's strongest reproducible signed contrasts are on short-range pair-distance shell densities (endpoint_effects:9-11 positive with positive batch fraction 1.0; endpoint_effects:13 negative with positive batch fraction 0.0; branch_adjusted:163,164,240,241,86,87), but the executing pointcloud scalar contains no pair-kernel term (formula_registry diagnostic_limit; observable_definitions scope). No registered bounded edit (pointcloud_delta_A, region_index, teacher_neighbors, temporal_region_index, temporal_teacher_blend) changes a pair-kernel observable, so the leading hypothesis cannot be expressed by any permitted edit; selecting one would be an unconnected edit rather than an operative reward change. The landmark soft-min/occupancy contrasts (endpoint_effects:14,15,32,34,68,70; regional_effects:0,70,100,180) are opposing in sign within a landmark and are not a validated contrast function, and the temporal recipes require validated contrast functions that the continuous trends do not supply (continuous:0-9 polynomial_accepted false, extrapolation_allowed false, relative node RMSE 0.29-0.87, strong sign conflicts up to 18; curve_support legendre_runtime_allowed false). Survival credit is recorded joint-head credit, not decoded terminal affinity (survival_effects:0,70,100,186,56,96,146; decoded_terminal_learning_labels_available false), and increment contrasts disagree in direction with selection and survival evidence (increment_effects:14,15,3,4,7,10,13), so no defensible expected advantage over the incumbent is established. Turnover residuals are accounting diagnostics including score reclassification and extant-parent weighting (turnover:1,2,14,17,47,134,224,227,254,497,584), not causal selection effects. Joint-motion diagnostics are negative and reproducible (branch_adjusted:74-76,151-153,228-230,305-307) but are pose/shape diagnostics, not evidence of neural-module causation, and no permitted edit targets them. Global centroid contrasts are weak or null (branch_adjusted:0-2,77-79; endpoint_effects:0-2), so no centroid constraint is warranted. Temperatures are immutable and no temperature edit is proposed. Retaining the incumbent is the defensible choice under the affinity-first priority; the evidence that would change this decision is a permitted edit whose registered formula changes a coordinate observable carrying a reproducible signed contrast with same-sign batch fraction at or above 0.857 and q below 0.05, or a validated temporal contrast function meeting the curve-fidelity criteria.
